item.description:

item.title: [6.0] TANGO: Humanoid Navigation in Cluttered Environments with a Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Model
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

We study the problem of navigating cluttered indoor environments with a humanoid robot. Unlike conventional methods that model navigation as a 2D path planning problem, humanoid traversal in cluttered environments requires continuous geometry-aware whole-body adaptation, including coordinated arm placement, torso adjustment, and gait modulation for collision-free movement through complex 3D...

WHY IT MATTERS

Extends vision-language integration for complex real-world reasoning and interaction.
